name: An Unfortunate End
objectiveText: Completion The deceased Night Watchman lying before you is covered in deep gashes and cuts. It's clear to see that he was mauled by some sort of large beast. You notice that the corpse has an unlit torch in his hand. You reach down and pry it from his stiff fingers. This could be useful in your travels through Duskwood and beyond to reveal things hidden by darkness.

comments.body: If Blizzard is going to add cool toys like this, I feel like they should add the toy collection tab like in retail to free up bag space and to be shared between your alt. I really like this torch, but it sucks that it take up bag space and while I don't mind having to run over to Duskwood to get it once. I don't want to do it 9+ times.
replies: idk why this was downvoted, I agree. They already have collections for everything else.
